issues.desc: The 관보 index has no appointment notice for 한민구 (2014-06-30), 송영무 (2017-07-13) and 정경두 (2018-09-21). The full harvested corpus (harvest/gazette_text, 2,709 인사 items 2001-01 to 2026-09, GAZETTE_DONE present) was grepped with a space-tolerant '국방부장관에 보함' pattern and returns 13 notices, none for these three, and targeted date and keyword searches (scripts defense_07_gazette_scan.py, keyword search on gwanbo) also found nothing. Their start dates rest on 청와대/국방부 releases on 정책브리핑 (tier 2), same-day news and ko.wikipedia. Round-2 verifier note. The search was extended from the indexed 인사 items to the full text of every whole gazette issue (script defense_verify2_02_gazette_issues.py), 28 issues for 2014-06-30..2014-08-08, 26 for 2017-07-13..2017-08-18 and 31 for 2018-09-21..2018-11-09. No appointment notice for the three appears. Only countersignatures on 대통령령 appear (earliest 2014-07-16, 2017-07-24 and 2018-09-28), which agree with the start dates. The three other ministers appointed on 2018-09-21 (성윤모, 이재갑, 진선미) are in 관보 제19356호 of 2018-10-15, and 정경두 is not, so the omission is in the gazette itself. The 2014-06-30 issue 제18295호 (about 264 MB) and the 2014-08-08 issue 제18324호 could not be downloaded.

강신철 (appointed 2026-09-22) has no 관보 notice yet. The gazette index was re-queried at 2026-09-25T21:32:07-0400 and has no category-19 item after 제21325호 of 2026-09-18. The start date rests on 연합뉴스, BigKinds items of 2026-09-22 and 2026-09-23 from six outlets, the 국방부 press release and daily briefing on 정책브리핑, and ko.wikipedia. Recheck when the notice is published. Round-2 verifier note. Re-queried with refresh at 2026-09-25T22:06:10-0400. The category-19 index has no item for 2026-09-19..09-25, and the whole issues 제21327호 (09-22) and 제21328호 (09-23) do not name him. No issue is listed for 09-24 or 09-25 yet.

Two exits needed a judgment on 'last day in office'. For 조영길 the 사표 수리 was announced on 2004-07-28 and the successor was appointed on 2004-07-29 (handover ceremony that day). His end is set to 2004-07-28 under the acceptance-day rule. For 김태영 the 사의 수용 was announced on 2010-11-25, but he stayed in office and answered as 국방부장관 in the 국방위원회 on 2010-11-30 (transcript meeting 40112). End set to the successor's appointment day, 2010-12-04. Downstream code should not treat these two cases differently by accident.

Pre-2001 dates (김동진 start 1996-10-18 and end 1998-03-03, 천용택 1998-03-03 to 1999-05-24, 조성태 start 1999-05-24) rest on same-day news (연합뉴스 via Naver, BigKinds metadata) and ko.wikipedia, because gwanbo.go.kr has no files before 2001. Confidence is 'medium'.

Confidence convention used here. 'high' means a 관보 notice (start) or a gazette-dated successor plus same-day news of the exit (end). 'medium' means tier 2 or tier 3 sources that agree, with no gazette. 'inferred_from_successor' means only the successor's appointment date is known for the exit.

ko.wikipedia list (revid 42533700) disagrees with the gazette or same-day news by one day at several boundaries, namely 김동신 end/이준 start (wiki 2002-07-12, gazette 2002-07-11), 조영길 end (wiki 2004-07-29), 윤광웅 end/김장수 start (wiki 2006-11-24, gazette 2006-11-23), 이상희 end (wiki 2009-09-22, handover 2009-09-23), 김관진 end (wiki 2014-06-29, successor 2014-06-30), 서욱 end/이종섭 start (wiki 2022-05-11, gazette 2022-05-10). The gazette or news date is used in each case.

Name and birth-date variants. 안규백 hanja is 安圭伯 in na_members_15_22.csv and ko.wikipedia but 安圭佰 in the 2025 gazette text, and his birth date is 1961-04-29 in na_members_15_22.csv but 1961-06-12 in ko.wikipedia. 이상희 is 李相喜 in the gazette and 李相憙 in 연합뉴스 and ko.wikipedia. 이종섭 is 李鍾燮 in the gazette and 李鐘燮 in ko.wikipedia. Gazette hanja is used except for 안규백 (NA record). Birth dates for non-MPs come from ko.wikipedia only.
name_en is null for every spell. No official or NA romanization source was consulted for this lineage.

Old panel errors found for this lineage (leads only). It has no rows for 조성태, 김동신, 이준 and the 1998 holdover 김동진 or 천용택. It also has wrong boundaries such as 조영길-윤광웅 2004-07-01, 김태영 end 2010-11-26, 김관진 split at 2013-02-25, 한민구 end 2017-03-10, 송영무 2017-07-03 to 2019-01-14, 신원식 end 2024-11-22 and 김용현 start 2024-11-22 (true start 2024-09-06, which answers the 'short tenure 2024-11..2024-12' lead).

One vacancy in the window: 김용현's 면직 on 2024-12-05 to 안규백's appointment on 2025-07-25, 231 uncovered days (2024-12-06 to 2025-07-24). Two 차관 acted in turn. 김선호 served from 2024-12-05 until his 이임 on 2025-06-27 (204 days). 이두희, appointed 차관 on 2025-06-27 (관보 제21029호), acted from 2025-06-27 to 2025-07-25. All other handovers are same-day, except 조영길 (resignation accepted 2004-07-28) to 윤광웅 (appointed 2004-07-29), which leaves no uncovered day.

The 국방부 official 역대장관 list (mnd.go.kr, read through Wayback captures of 2018-11 and 2025-11) names the same 18 holders 김동진 to 김용현 as this file, so no holder is missing. Its dates follow two conventions that differ from this roster. Starts are 취임식 days where they differ (이준 2002.7.12, 송영무 2017.7.14, 이종섭 2022.5.11, against gazette or 임명장 dates 2002-07-11, 2017-07-13, 2022-05-10). Ends are usually the day before the successor's start (for example 이상희 2009.9.22, 김관진 2014.6.29, 정경두 2020.9.17). No value in this file was changed on the basis of that list.

Naver News search (search.naver.com) now renders only the first result server-side, so src.naver_news_search returned 0 URLs for most verifier queries on 2026-09-25. The verifier used BigKinds metadata, 정책브리핑 and Naver article pages found earlier instead.

Provenance of this file. It was rebuilt on resume from the builder output of 2026-09-25T13:25 (defense.partial.json) together with the adversarial verification pass of 2026-09-25T14:15 (defense.verified.json, scripts defense_verify_01 to 15). That pass changed no spell or nomination date. It corrected the acting list (김선호 to 2025-06-27, then 차관 이두희 to 2025-07-25) and appended independent sources to every spell, and those corrections are carried here. The resume pass (scripts defense_16_resume_check.py and defense_17_resume_build.py) re-grepped the gazette corpus (13 국방부장관 notices, each matching a spell start), re-queried the gazette index for 강신철, and added sources for 이종섭's end_reason and for 강신철 being in office on 2026-09-24.

Round-2 verifier correction. 윤광웅's end_reason was 'replaced' although he offered his resignation on 2006-10-23 and the President decided on 2006-10-25 to accept it. Changed to 'resigned' for consistency with 조영길, 김태영 and 이종섭. A BigKinds check for resignation offers before the other 'replaced' exits (김동신, 조성태, 천용택, 이상희, 한민구, 송영무, 정경두, 서욱, 김관진, 안규백) found none (script defense_verify2_11_resign_offers.py).

Round-2 verifier note on dual office. 김관진 held 국가안보실장 from 2014-06-23 and 신원식 from 2024-08-12 (per the builder's sources) while still 국방부장관. Neither spell changes. The dual-office review should read both notes.
